_meta.description: Repository-native English string source for The Grimoire.

en.text: Your living record and covenant engine.

The Grimoire is the system that holds the entire Living Blueprint together. It is where you give God consent, focus that consent with sigils, write covenant clauses that shape real change, take one aligned step at a time, and log fruit and testimony to confirmations. It is not a diary or spellbook. It is a clean, repeatable way to turn revelation into movement.
Your living record and covenant engine.

to confirmations. It is not a diary or spellbook. It is a clean, repeatable way to turn revelation into movement.
Truth stays visible; distortion loses hiding places. Decisions, grief, and repeating loops become trackable. You stop drifting and start building — steadily, without collapse.
Anyone who wants direct life-with-God, free of gatekeepers and fear, and is willing to be honest, consistent, and kind.

ja.text: 最初のページに次のように書いてください：
「<あなたの名前>のグリモワール」

en.text: "I give God access to my heart, mind, and life. I seek truth without distortion and agree to walk aligned."

zh.text: “我允许神进入我的心、思想和生命。我寻求不受歪曲的真理，并同意按照与真理一致的方向前行。”

ja.text: 「私は神に、私の心と思考と人生へ入ることを許します。私は歪みのない真実を求め、それと一致して歩むことに同意します。」

ko.text: "나는 하나님께 내 마음과 생각과 삶에 들어오실 수 있도록 허락합니다. 나는 왜곡 없는 진실을 구하며, 그 진실에 맞추어 살아가기로 동의합니다."

fr.text: « J’accorde à Dieu l’accès à mon cœur, à mon esprit et à ma vie. Je recherche la vérité sans distorsion et j’accepte de marcher en accord avec elle. »

de.text: „Ich gebe Gott Zugang zu meinem Herzen, meinem Denken und meinem Leben. Ich suche nach unverzerrter Wahrheit und stimme zu, im Einklang mit ihr zu gehen.“

es.text: «Doy a Dios acceso a mi corazón, mi mente y mi vida. Busco la verdad sin distorsión y acepto caminar en consonancia con ella.»

pt.text: “Dou a Deus acesso ao meu coração, à minha mente e à minha vida. Busco a verdade sem distorção e concordo em caminhar em alinhamento com ela.”

ar.text: «أمنح الله الوصول إلى قلبي وعقلي وحياتي. أطلب الحقيقة من دون تحريف، وأوافق على أن أسير بما ينسجم معها.»

hi.text: "परमेश्वर को मेरे हृदय, मन और जीवन तक पहुँच मिले। मैं विकृति-रहित सत्य की खोज में हूँ और उसके अनुरूप चलने के लिए सहमत हूँ।"

en.text: One primary place only: a paper journal (recommended) or a single digital notebook/vault named "Grimoire."

zh.text: 只使用一个主要载体：纸质日记本（推荐），或一个名为“Grimoire”的单一数字笔记本/资料库。

ko.text: 기본 장소는 하나만 사용하세요: 종이 저널(권장) 또는 "Grimoire"라는 이름의 단일 디지털 노트/보관함.

fr.text: Un seul support principal : un journal papier (recommandé) ou un unique carnet/coffre numérique nommé « Grimoire ».

de.text: Nur ein einziger Hauptort: ein Papierjournal (empfohlen) oder ein einzelnes digitales Notizbuch/ein digitaler Tresor namens „Grimoire“.

es.text: Un solo lugar principal: un diario en papel (recomendado) o un único cuaderno/bóveda digital llamado «Grimoire».

pt.text: Apenas um local principal: um diário em papel (recomendado) ou um único caderno/cofre digital chamado “Grimoire”.

ar.text: مكان أساسي واحد فقط: دفتر يوميات ورقي (موصى به) أو دفتر/خزنة رقمية واحدة باسم «Grimoire».

hi.text: केवल एक मुख्य स्थान: काग़ज़ी जर्नल (अनुशंसित) या "Grimoire" नाम की एक ही डिजिटल नोटबुक/वॉल्ट।

ja.text: 毎日のループを始める

en.text: Invoke one sigil → ask for one nudge → take one small step → log it → watch for confirmation → close in peace.

zh.text: 祈请一个符印 → 请求一个提示 → 迈出一小步 → 记录它 → 留意确认 → 于平安中结束。

ja.text: 一つのシジルを呼び起こす → 一つの促しを求める → 小さな一歩を踏み出す → 記録する → 確認を見守る → 平安のうちに閉じる。

ko.text: 시질 하나를 기원 → 한 가지 신호를 요청 → 작은 한 걸음을 실행 → 기록 → 확인을 지켜봄 → 평안 속에서 마침.

fr.text: Invoquez un sigil → demandez une impulsion → faites un petit pas → consignez-le → guettez une confirmation → clôturez dans la paix.

de.text: Rufe eine Sigille an → bitte um einen Impuls → mache einen kleinen Schritt → protokolliere ihn → achte auf Bestätigung → schließe in Frieden.

es.text: Invoca un sigilo → pide una señal → da un pequeño paso → regístralo → observa si llega confirmación → cierra en paz.

pt.text: Invoque um sigilo → peça um sinal → dê um pequeno passo → registre-o → observe a confirmação → encerre em paz.

ar.text: استدعِ سيجيلًا واحدًا → اطلب إشارة واحدة → خذ خطوة صغيرة → سجّلها → راقب التأكيد → اختم بسلام.

hi.text: एक सिगिल का आह्वान करें → एक संकेत माँगें → एक छोटा कदम उठाएँ → उसे दर्ज करें → पुष्टि पर ध्यान दें → शांति में समाप्त करें।

es.text: Ora y luego haz un boceto

en.text: Pray: "God, show me the simple symbol for ___." Sketch the first clean form. Keep it minimal and consistent.

zh.text: 祈祷：“神，请向我显明 ___ 的简洁符号。”画出第一个清晰的形态。保持简洁且一致。

ja.text: 祈る：「神よ、___ を表すシンプルな象徴を示してください。」最初のすっきりした形を描く。簡潔で一貫したものに保つ。

ko.text: 기도하세요: "하나님, ___을 위한 단순한 상징을 보여 주세요." 처음 떠오른 깔끔한 형태를 그리세요. 단순하고 일관되게 유지하세요.

fr.text: Priez : « Dieu, montre-moi le symbole simple de ___. » Esquissez la première forme nette. Gardez-la minimale et cohérente.

de.text: Bete: „Gott, zeig mir das einfache Symbol für ___.“ Skizziere die erste klare Form. Halte sie minimal und konsistent.

es.text: Ora: «Dios, muéstrame el símbolo sencillo de ___.» Dibuja la primera forma clara. Mantenla simple y coherente.

pt.text: Ore: “Deus, mostre-me o símbolo simples para ___.” Esboce a primeira forma limpa. Mantenha-a mínima e consistente.

ar.text: صلِّ: «يا الله، أرني الرمز البسيط لـ ___.» ارسم أول شكل واضح. اجعله بسيطًا ومتسقًا.

hi.text: प्रार्थना करें: "परमेश्वर, मुझे ___ का सरल प्रतीक दिखाएँ।" पहला साफ़ रूप रेखांकित करें। उसे सरल और सुसंगत रखें।

ja.text: シジルは神を指し示すものであり、神に取って代わるものではない。

ko.text: 시질은 하나님을 가리킬 뿐, 하나님을 대신하지 않습니다.

de.text: Sigillen weisen auf Gott; sie ersetzen Gott niemals.

ar.text: السيجيلات تشير إلى الله؛ ولا تحل محل الله أبدًا.

hi.text: सिगिल परमेश्वर की ओर संकेत करते हैं; वे कभी परमेश्वर का स्थान नहीं लेते।

en.text: (never against identities or people groups). Each clause page contains:

zh.text: 示例 — 健康的人际关系

ja.text: 例 — 健全な人間関係

en.text: I dwell in relationships built on honesty, care, and repair.

zh.text: 我处在以诚实、关怀和修复为基础的关系中。

ja.text: 私は、誠実さ、思いやり、そして修復を土台とする関係の中にいる。

ko.text: 나는 정직, 돌봄, 회복을 바탕으로 한 관계 속에 머뭅니다.

fr.text: J’habite des relations fondées sur l’honnêteté, l’attention et la réparation.

de.text: Ich lebe in Beziehungen, die auf Ehrlichkeit, Fürsorge und Wiedergutmachung beruhen.

es.text: Vivo en relaciones construidas sobre la honestidad, el cuidado y la reparación.

pt.text: Vivo em relacionamentos construídos sobre honestidade, cuidado e reparação.

ar.text: أعيش في علاقات مبنية على الصدق والرعاية والإصلاح.

hi.text: मैं ऐसे संबंधों में रहता/रहती हूँ जो ईमानदारी, देखभाल और सुधार पर बने हैं।

en.text: I step out of spaces that glorify contempt, manipulation, or abuse.

zh.text: 我离开那些美化蔑视、操纵或虐待的空间。

ja.text: 侮蔑、操作、虐待を賛美する場からは離れる。

ko.text: 나는 경멸, 조종, 학대를 미화하는 공간에서 나옵니다.

fr.text: Je quitte les espaces qui glorifient le mépris, la manipulation ou les abus.

de.text: Ich verlasse Räume, die Verachtung, Manipulation oder Missbrauch verherrlichen.

es.text: Me aparto de espacios que glorifican el desprecio, la manipulación o el abuso.

pt.text: Eu me retiro de ambientes que glorificam desprezo, manipulação ou abuso.

ar.text: أبتعد عن المساحات التي تمجّد الاحتقار أو التلاعب أو الإساءة.

hi.text: मैं उन जगहों से बाहर निकलता/निकलती हूँ जो तिरस्कार, हेरफेर या दुर्व्यवहार को महिमामंडित करती हैं।

en.text: Weekly truth check-in; same-day repair when I miss; no ghosting.

zh.text: 每周进行一次真诚核对；若我有失误，当天修复；不无故失联。

ja.text: 毎週、真実を確認する時間を持つ。失敗したらその日のうちに修復する。音信不通にして消えない。

ko.text: 매주 진실한 점검을 하고, 내가 놓쳤다면 그날 바로 회복하며, 잠수하지 않습니다.

fr.text: Point vérité chaque semaine ; réparation le jour même si je manque ; pas de disparition sans explication.

de.text: Wöchentlicher Wahrheits-Check-in; noch am selben Tag reparieren, wenn ich etwas verfehle; kein Ghosting.

es.text: Revisión semanal de honestidad; reparación el mismo día cuando fallo; nada de desaparecer sin explicación.

pt.text: Revisão semanal de honestidade; reparação no mesmo dia quando eu falhar; nada de sumir sem explicação.

ar.text: مراجعة أسبوعية صادقة؛ إصلاح في اليوم نفسه عندما أخطئ؛ لا اختفاء بلا تفسير.

hi.text: साप्ताहिक सत्य-जाँच; चूक होने पर उसी दिन सुधार; बिना बताए गायब नहीं होना।

en.text: Consent, no coercion, invite counsel if conflict escalates.

zh.text: 同意，不胁迫；若冲突升级，请可信的顾问介入。

ja.text: 同意を大切にし、強制しない。対立が激化したら助言者を招く。

ko.text: 동의, 강요하지 않기, 갈등이 심해지면 조언을 구합니다.

pt.text: Eu me sinto mais seguro/a; os conflitos se resolvem mais rápido em até 8 semanas.

What follows is not a second system. It is what the Grimoire looks like when someone has lived it consistently over time. The original blueprint above is the ground — everything here grew from that ground.

The Grimoire SDK is a framework for treating your entire grimoire as one sealed whole. The opening and closing sigils mark your grimoire as one unit — eliminating the need for repetition. The sigil represents the covenant lock: your soul's key and witness.

The SDK is a framework, not a rulebook. You may call your opening and closing marks sigils, symbols, or simply bookends. What matters is that they define the boundaries of your grimoire so your intent is read as one whole. Any symbol you choose, if clearly declared and used consistently, will carry the same covenant weight.

The act of writing with your own hand is the spiritual audit trail — it records your soul's choice in ink. Mistakes in spelling or form do not break the covenant, for it is the heart that God receives.
Customization is welcome. Use a mark that feels true to you, and honor it each time you open and close your grimoire. The intention must be clear for God to receive and honor.
These are examples — not commands. The categories are universal patterns. The form you choose to express them is yours.
This page is where you declare why your book exists and what it will protect, grow, and hold for you. Purpose turns your entries into covenant.
Without purpose, the tools scatter. With purpose, every sigil and protocol aligns.

You may write with God as your witness, or with the presence you trust most deeply — whether that is truth, love, spirit, nature, ancestors, or your higher self. What matters is that you declare your purpose clearly and faithfully. The hand that writes is the vessel. The witness you choose is the seal. Both together create alignment.
"I am aligned with truth. Let my life be a witness to love."
"Protection: I walk shielded; my steps are witnessed."

Treat this section as a gallery: look, learn, then build your own.
A game of inner conversation guided by curiosity.
See what happens when you keep talking to yourself… and actually listen.
Write a sentence. Anything. Even if it's: "I don't know what I'm doing." "This is dumb." "I feel weird writing this." That's perfect. Start wherever you are.

At the end of your sentence… ask a question. Any question that feels honest. It can be to yourself, to God, to no one. "Why am I even doing this?" "What do I want right now?" "What am I afraid to admit?" Just let the question appear.
Now respond to that question — as if you're replying to a friend. Or a stranger. Or maybe… something more. Then ask another question. Then answer that. Repeat.

You might argue with yourself. You might get bored… then accidentally say something real. You might cry. You might write something so honest it surprises you. That's how the game works. The more curious you become, the deeper it goes.
"But what if I don't hear anything back?" Keep writing anyway. Sometimes it takes a few pages before something clicks or responds. But when it does… you'll know.

Each way you talk to yourself carries a different kind of energy. Writing it down builds something. Speaking it out wakes something up. Thinking it quietly stirs something deep. You don't have to know how it works — the knowing will come as you walk. Just try each and see what feels different.
You're not just writing. You're shifting something.
This is how revelation becomes a life you can actually walk.
